statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations
There is clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is required
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was billed with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
